_doc: Clean-room registry. One universe per counterpart or canon corpus. Atoms never cross universes: a query names ONE universe; bridging needs --bridge with --why and is logged. anti_aliases = names that look like the entity but are NOT it (a query containing one gets a conflation warning; an atom may mention one only if type=collision). audience: every atom is internal unless tagged external; external is allowed only on type=claim, grade A/B/C, and a public projection (--project public) replaces names with the client's SHAPE (registry shape/name_shapes, what it does, never a hand-picked alias; null = refuse) and prints an opaque tag from the private hash table sources/pseudonym-key.json (gitignored). tier=canon is read-only: built by scripts/universe_canon_adapter.py from _CANON/ and _DECISIONS/, no counterpart name may appear in it. grades: A primary document authored by the entity, B self-reported by the subject, C second-hand (relayed), inference, hypothesis. tier=personal: a person's own receipts, always internal, no public projection; atoms name counterparts only through declared `bridges`.
